theorems.name: Submission.regcomp_restriction_integer_multiplicity
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U A : Set (Euclid P)) (T T₁ : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R : IMRep U n), IsOpen U → R.Represents T → MeasurableSet A → μHE[n] (A \ R.carrier) = 0 → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, T₁ ω = ∫ x in A, R.orient x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x) ∂μHE[n]) → IsIntegerMultiplicity T₁ ∧ IsIntegerMultiplicity (T - T₁) ∧ (∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → T₁.massOn W + (T - T₁).massOn W = T.massOn W) ∧ ∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → CompactlyContained W U → (T - T₁).massOn W ≠ ∞
